advancements.kronwerke.minenwelt.title: Into the Farm World
kronwerke.bar.hidden: The goal bar is hidden. /kw bar brings it back.
kronwerke.boss.chaos_1: 1. The four guardian crystals on the pillars heal and shield him. While they stand, he cannot be hurt.
kronwerke.boss.chaos_2: 2. Every crystal has a shield that grows back: take the shield down, then break the crystal at once. Arrows, spells and melee all count.
kronwerke.boss.chaos_3: 3. Without crystals he can be hurt, and he is furious: fireballs, lasers, area damage. Stay together, heal, take turns tanking.
kronwerke.boss.chaos_4: 4. After the win: the chaos crystal in the middle. Mining it gives the chaos shards, then the island blows up. Fly away first, cheer later.
kronwerke.boss.lightning: The boss has its eye on you.
